description: Skin injury caused by heat, chemicals, electricity, radiation, or friction.

appearance.general: Redness, pain, blistering, or deeper tissue injury may occur depending on severity.

warning_signs: Large burns, deep burns, facial or genital burns, electrical or chemical burns, or signs of inhalation injury require urgent medical evaluation.
general_first_aid: Cool the burn with cool running water as soon as practical after injury.
Do not apply ice directly to the burn.
